title: Spring Salad
notes: The PiDGen kitchen team initially designed this salad to feature mackerel. For a staff meal one day, a team member developed an Asian herb tofu marinade and the result was so good, it quickly took the place of the mackerel on the Spring Salad. A great example of experimentation and fusion, obviously this is what PiDGen is all about. Feel free to try experimenting with this recipe, too.

ingredientSections.heading: Tofu Marinade
items: ½ bunch cilantro, stalks and all
½ bunch mint, picked from stems
½ bunch Thai basil, picked from stems

methodSections.heading: Wasabi-Yogurt Dressing
steps: Place all the ingredients in a bowl except the yogurt, salt and pepper and whisk together.
Very slowly at first, add the canola oil, a drizzle at a time, and continue whisking until the mixture emulsifies. You could also use a food processor.
Fold the yogurt through the creamy dressing and season with salt and pepper to taste. Can be refrigerated for up to 3 days.

methodSections.heading: Tofu Marinade
steps: Slice the tofu into bite-sized cubes.
Blend, or chop everything else together and pour over the tofu. Allow to marinate for at least 4 hours.

methodSections.heading: Quick Pickled Red Cabbage
steps: Finely slice the red cabbage or use a mandolin.
In a bowl, mix together all the ingredients really well.
Allow to marinate for at least 30 minutes, but longer is better.

methodSections.heading: Onsen Eggs
steps: Fill a large pot with lots of water and place over a medium heat. Set the thermometer up in a way that the probe is in the water but you don't need to hold it.
Monitor the thermometer and adjust the heat accordingly until the water is hovering around 75°C. Have a jug of cold water handy to cool the water if necessary.
Add the eggs and start a timer. The eggs will reduce the temperature of the water so, again, adjust the heat as necessary.

Remove the eggs after 15 minutes and place in an ice bath to stop the cooking. Gently break each egg into a bowl. There may be some looser egg whites separate from the cooked part, if so, remove with a spoon or paper towel.

methodSections.heading: Spring Salad
steps: Add the arugula, edamame, peas and finely sliced cucumber to a bowl and toss. Divide the salad into 4 serving bowls.
Sprinkle some of the pickled cabbage and arrange some of the tofu on top.
Drizzle with some of the wasabi yogurt dressing.
Place an onsen egg in the middle.
